reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small-business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice, respects operating boundaries, and adheres strictly to the no-CTA brief.
reasons.clarity: The core point, workflow boundaries, and diagnostic steps are logically structured and immediately understandable on a first read without jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, low-friction diagnostic exercise (auditing one week of invoices) while clearly reinforcing human-approval boundaries.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsupported claims, avoids inventing metrics or customer results, and keeps all workflow concepts strictly within approved boundaries.
